cwReadFailed: The card couldn’t be read from the Engine. Trying again.
cwRefreshFailed: Couldn’t refresh the card. Showing what it last read.
cwMissing: This card isn’t on your board. It may have been taken off, or given to an Agent you can’t see.
evUnlinked: No longer waits for another card
cwAssignBusy: An Agent is working on this card now. Stop it first, then give it to someone else.
cwAssignFailed: The assignee wasn’t changed. Try again.
cwTitleMissing: A card needs a title, even two words.
cwDescriptionHint: Markdown: “- [ ]” makes a to-do. Ctrl+Enter saves, Esc cancels.
cwChanged: Someone changed this while you were editing. Your words are still here: check the card, then save again.
cwCommentFailed: The comment wasn’t posted. Try again.
cwAnswerEmpty: Write your answer first, even one word.
cwAnswerFailed: The answer wasn’t sent. Try again.
cwNotAsking: It isn’t waiting for an answer any more. The card was read again.
cwFailedWhy: It failed twice in a row and stopped. Continue asks it to try again.
cwContinueFailed: It didn’t go on. Try again.
cwNotStopped: It isn’t stopped any more. The card was read again.
cwNotRunning: It isn’t working on the card now. The card was read again.
cwNoWaitChoice: No other card it can wait for
cwFileNotNow: Can’t be read now: the work sandbox is stopped.
cwFileUnservable: This file isn’t in the Agent’s own folder, so it can’t be downloaded.
cwFileTooLarge: “{0}” wasn’t added: a card’s file can be at most {1} MB.
cwFileNotAllowed: You can read this card, not add to it.
